messages:
marta: quick q - we need to lock down the telemetry contract for A/B canaries + the fallback resolver API before the refactor next week. i sketched something, want feedback.

kai: do you mean the shape of events we emit, or the decision inputs the resolver will consume?

marta: both. events so the rollout dashboard + automated rollback can rely on consistent fields. resolver inputs so that Dedicated/Private routers can call it in a standard way.

ara: +1. important to include variant metadata (model_id, quantization, config_tag) and signal provenance (router, local_probe, observer).

sam: can we keep the event minimal for high-throughput paths? i.e., sampled detailed events + cheap counters per-variant.

marta: that's the idea. two-tier: envelope (always emitted) + detail blob (sampled). envelope = what the rollback/guardrail needs.

devon: sketch?

marta: pasted quick sketch below:

```json
{
  "envelope": {
    "tenant_id": "T-123",
    "request_id": "r-456",
    "timestamp": 1755002468000,
    "variant": "v2-quant8",
    "model_family": "redwood-3b",
    "latency_ms": 122,
    "status": "ok|error|timeout",
    "signal_source": "router|observer|client"
  },
  "detail": {
    "prompt_len": 78,
    "tokens_generated": 42,
    "confidence_estimate": 0.87,
    "kv_cache_hit": true
  }
}
```

kai: looks fine. for the envelope, can we standardize status codes instead of freeform status? e.g., 0=ok,1=warn,2=err,3=timeout. easier to index.

marta: yes, good call. also we should add a small "decision_reason" field when a fallback happens so audits can trace why resolver picked fallback.

sam: about the resolver API: i propose a simple sync call + async webhook for long ops. sync should return immediate preferred variant and fallback policy. sample proto: 

POST /v1/resolver/evaluate
body: { tenant_id, request_context, candidate_variants[], traffic_hint }
response: { chosen_variant, fallback_policy: [fallback_variant...], ttl_seconds, reason_code }

ara: include an optional "strict":true flag so callers that must avoid quality degradation can force stricter selection (higher SLO bar)

devon: what about runtime locality? Dedicated routers shouldn't always call central resolver for every request. need a small consistent-hash cache + lease.

marta: yes, resolver must be cacheable. response includes ttl + a lease_token. routers can serve from cache but must report cache-miss counts and decision divergence telemetry.

sam: can we piggyback fallback signals into existing observability paths to avoid new ingestion? envelope fields map cleanly to trace/span tags.

marta: agreed. map envelope.request_id to trace id and attach variant tags. simplifies correlation with existing error budgets.

kai: rollout guardrails: what signals trigger automatic fallback? latency p90 > X, error_rate > Y, quality regression on eval-set. we need a small DSL for policies.

marta: thinking json policy: 

{ "conditions": [{"metric":"p90_latency","op":">","value":300,"window_s":300}], "action": "fallback_to", "target": "v1-stable" }

devon: fyi deploy-bot just posted a canary in staging which will exercise the flow.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary/variant=v2-quant8 started on staging (id: canary-202503). :rocket:

ara: any concerns about PII in detail blob for Private deployments? we should default detail to stripped and allow opt-in via enterprise config.

marta: good flag. detail must be redacted by default for Private; envelope stays minimal and GDPR-safe.

sam: operational checklist?

marta: short list: 1) finalize envelope schema + enumerations, 2) resolver API spec w/ ttl/lease/reason, 3) rollout policy DSL v1, 4) sampling defaults & privacy knobs, 5) add trace tags mapping.

kai: i'll take (1) and (5). sam can own (4). ara take (2). devon take (3) and integrate with router cache.

marta: perfect. i'll open an RFC PR with the sketches + examples and link tests. aim to merge by EOD Friday.

devon: tiny nit - include a metric for "fallback_applied_count" per-variant so we can spot oscillations.

marta: added. thanks.

sam: lgtm. :+1:

kai: thanks — i'll start writing the envelope enums.

deploy-bot: note: canary/variant=v2-quant8 completed smoke checks in staging. status: green.

marta: great. i'll kick off the RFC PR now and ping reviewers.
